reports.description: Website that scams people out of money via promise of a Bitcoin/Forex payout. In my case, a relative was contacted by someone claiming to be a celebrity who made an account in the relatives name with a deposit of 2000 pounds sterling. The people in charge of the site will say that you have to deposit X amount of money in your account in order to withdraw funds. This amount will increase over time due to interest rates, or so the site will say. This will lead to being charged an ever increasing amount of money in order to withdraw. On top of this, they claim youll have to deposit more money in order to pay taxes. After obtaining my relatives wallet address on the site and making a spoof account of my own, it seems as though all accounts actually have the same crypto wallet address. This is a Grade-A Scam.
